newForms.name: Deepglub
newForms.lore: Its bubble-patterns are getting complicated enough that scholars are starting to take notes.

newForms.name: Glubtitan
newForms.lore: Patrols the deepest trench in the Lakes and hums a note nothing else can reach.

newForms.name: Glubsovereign
newForms.lore: The Lakes have a pressure and a pulse now, and both belong to it.

newForms.name: Bellowcroak
newForms.lore: Now heard four lakes away. It considers this an improvement, not a problem.

newForms.name: Deepcroak
newForms.lore: Dives so deep to croak that the fish there have started answering back.

newForms.name: Thundercroak
newForms.lore: One croak can clear a flock of gulls off the water. Two can clear the weather.

newForms.name: Bellowking
newForms.lore: Every lake in the region sets its own dawn chorus around when it decides to start.

newForms.name: Cindermallow
newForms.lore: Toasts perfectly on the outside. Somehow still gooey within. Scientifically concerning.

newForms.name: Moltenmallow
newForms.lore: Sits in campfires for fun. The campfires lose that contest every time.

newForms.name: Infernmallow
newForms.lore: Ember Scar cooks call it the world's worst, most delicious camping hazard.

newForms.name: Bloomlime
newForms.lore: Flowers year-round now. Bees have started filing complaints about false alarms.

newForms.name: Groveslime
newForms.lore: A whole little garden lives inside it, and it waters them from within.

newForms.name: Edenlime
newForms.lore: The oldest gardeners in the Vale swear their best blooms all trace back to one very patient slime.

newForms.name: Voltjelly
newForms.lore: Hums at 60 hertz, then 90, then whatever it feels like that day.

newForms.name: Stormjelly
newForms.lore: Static builds so fast that nearby Mystics' fur stands on end just walking past.

newForms.name: Fulminjelly
newForms.lore: A lightning strike that never quite finished happening, and has decided it likes it that way.

newForms.name: Voidjelly
newForms.lore: Moonlight doesn't reflect off it anymore. It just quietly keeps it.

newForms.name: Nightjelly
newForms.lore: The new moon isn't dark because there's no moon. It's dark because this is nearby.

newForms.name: Eclipsejelly
newForms.lore: Old bog-tales say a Bubblin found a Void Stone once and simply never stopped changing. This is where the tale ends. Probably.

newForms.name: Alpastorm
newForms.lore: Its fleece carries static now. Sweaters made from it hum a little.

newForms.name: Alpatempest
newForms.lore: Leads the whole herd over the high passes before any storm even arrives.

newForms.name: Alpasovereign
newForms.lore: The high meadows have a weather pattern now, and it follows her mood.

newForms.name: Whirlisk
newForms.lore: Spins a slightly bigger whirlpool now. Boats disagree slightly more.

newForms.name: Maelisk
newForms.lore: Practices figure-eights in open water. The fish have learned to just go around.

newForms.name: Vortisk
newForms.lore: Can spin a whirlpool wide enough to see the bottom of the lake from the rim.

newForms.name: Maelsovereign
newForms.lore: Every whirlpool in Mirror Lakes answers to the same current, and the current answers to her.

newForms.name: Prismhart
newForms.lore: Its antlers now catch every colour of the aurora at once, not just the green.

newForms.name: Starhart
newForms.lore: Walks the ridgeline only when the sky is putting on its very best show.

newForms.name: Zenithart
newForms.lore: The peaks' own aurora bends toward wherever it happens to be standing.

newForms.name: Snapclack
newForms.lore: Upgraded to a full standing ovation. The lake shore has never been louder.

newForms.name: Ironclack
newForms.lore: Its claws have gone from applause to actual percussion instruments.

newForms.name: Titanclack
newForms.lore: Cracks boulders open on the shoreline just to see if it still can. It can.

newForms.name: Clackmonarch
newForms.lore: The whole reef claps when it claps. Nobody taught them to; it just happened.

newForms.name: Sandpinch
newForms.lore: Its shell bleached fully white under the desert sun. Looks fantastic. Feels like an oven.

newForms.name: Duneclad
newForms.lore: Buries itself in warm sand up to the eyestalks and calls that a vacation.

newForms.name: Boneclack
newForms.lore: Old caravans use its shed shell-plates as sun-bleached trail markers.

newForms.name: Sandmonarch
newForms.lore: The oasis has one true ruler, and it settles every dispute with a single unhurried clack.
